messages:
Alice Kim: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy inference-runtime v2.9 to prod tomorrow 09:00 PT (win: 09:00-09:30). Need quick acks on smoke plan + rollback readiness. TL;DR checklist below.

Ben Ortiz: Acked tentative window. I'm owner for rollout lane A (API gateway + serving). Will be on-call for the window.

Carla Nguyen: I'll do post-deploy integration smoke (latency, error-rate, kv-cache correctness). My checklist: 
- Run canary against 10% traffic for 10m
- Validate 95th latency <= 250ms
- Run 50k token regen quick compare set

Dave Patel: I'll handle infra checks and rollback hooks. Confirmed backup model snapshot + config commit ready. Rollback plan: revert to v2.8 image tag + clear new cache entries.

Eva Ross: I'll smoke the Console dashboards and tracing. Also verify rollout metrics come through (token breakdown, per-route).

Alice Kim: Checklist I'm asking folks to confirm before we flip: 
1) Owners present in window : Ben, Carla, Dave, Eva :thumbsup:
2) Canary traffic route ready (Ben)
3) Model artifact validated & signed (Dave)
4) Smoke test plan (Carla)
5) Rollback playbook posted (Dave)
6) Observability dashboards linked in runbook (Eva)
7) Post-deploy verification script path: `infra/runbooks/smoke_v2.9.sh`

Ben Ortiz: Canary route ready. Small note: we'll enable `continuous-batching=true` for canary only. Command to start canary: ```deploy-bot start-canary --service inference-runtime --tag v2.9 --percent 10 --duration 10m```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for inference-runtime:v2.9 at 2026-06-12T09:00:00Z, 10% traffic for 10m. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/v2.9-smoke

Carla Nguyen: Smoke script ready. Contents include: ```bash
# quick checks
curl -sS https://api.prod/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY' 
# latency binning, error rate check
```

Dave Patel: Rollback playbook pushed: https://git.redwood/platform/ops/rollbacks/inf-runtime-v2.9.md. Steps include image revert, cache invalidation, and traffic shift back to v2.8 over 5m. I also added a pre-check to ensure node pools have capacity for old image.

Eva Ross: Dashboards wired. I'll run an alert check at T-15. If anything anomalous shows during canary (error spikes > 0.5% or p95 > 350ms) we rollback.

Alice Kim: All right — final ask: owners please post a one-line ack here if you'll be available at 09:00 PT and comfortable with the checklist. I'll do the final greenlight at T-5.

Ben Ortiz: Ben — available, ack.

Carla Nguyen: Carla — available, ack.

Dave Patel: Dave — available, ack.

Eva Ross: Eva — available, ack.

Alice Kim: Great, thanks. I'll post the T-5 signoff and trigger the deploy. If any last-minute issues ping me or the #eng-oncall. :party-parrot:
